title: chromolaena caldensis
intro: Chromolaena caldensis, commonly known as Bitter Apple, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena caldensis include its antioxidant, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chromolaena caldensis include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
